integrity: All claims concern one exact classification, its theory counts, and its sharp representative sizes; no external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Finite level-homogeneous prefix trees only; pure strict-ancestry language without counting. Finite verification is corroboration, not the proof. A general pre-existing tree-pebble theorem might imply this specialization; independent validation and complete priority verification have not occurred.
title: Fixed-variable theories of finite level-homogeneous ancestry trees
